headline: Golden State Valkyries level WNBA finals against Atlanta Dream
standfirst: The Golden State Valkyries defeated the Atlanta Dream 67-62 to tie the WNBA finals series at two games apiece.
keyPoints: Golden State Valkyries beat Atlanta Dream 67-62 in Game 4.
The best-of-seven WNBA finals series is tied 2-2.
Gabby Williams led scoring for the Valkyries with 17 points.
Game 5 moves to San Francisco on Monday.

paragraphs: The Golden State Valkyries secured a hard-fought 67-62 victory over the Atlanta Dream on Saturday, evening the WNBA finals at two games apiece. Gabby Williams led the visiting side with 17 points, putting in a stellar defensive performance to halt a late comeback attempt from their opponents. The result brings the championship series to a tense tie as both franchises chase their first-ever league title.

Golden State established control early in the contest, building a 16-point advantage by halftime after forcing numerous turnovers and limiting Atlanta's offensive rhythm. Although the Dream mounted a determined second-half charge, cutting the deficit to five points in the closing moments, the Valkyries maintained their composure from the free-throw line. Tiffany Hayes and Veronica Burton each contributed 13 points to support the winning effort.

Atlanta relied on Rhyne Howard, who scored a game-high 19 points, alongside contributions from Jordin Canada and Izzy Borlase. However, star player Angel Reese was restricted to eight points following a tough defensive effort from the visitors. The action now shifts back to California for the crucial fifth game of the best-of-seven championship format.

sections.heading: Championship context and season background
paragraphs: Both finalists reached this stage after dominant postseason runs, having swept their respective semifinal opponents to earn a week of rest. The Dream overcame the New York Liberty, while the Valkyries eliminated the reigning champions, the Las Vegas Aces. This year marks only the second season in league history that the championship series has expanded to a best-of-seven format.

The broader 2026 campaign has proven groundbreaking both on and off the court following a historic labor agreement. A significant salary cap increase raised player compensation substantially, helping fuel numerous record-breaking individual and team achievements throughout the regular season. Both teams have carried that competitive momentum deep into the playoff bracket.

sections.heading: Scheduling challenges and venue uncertainty
paragraphs: Aside from the on-court action, league organisers face a logistical hurdle regarding the potential Game 6 venue in Atlanta. State Farm Arena, where the Dream have hosted their postseason matches, is simultaneously booked for an NBA fixture involving the Atlanta Hawks on the same evening. Because the primary arena cannot accommodate two simultaneous sporting events, league officials are evaluating alternative solutions for the fixture.

Several possibilities exist, including shifting the match to alternative local venues or exploring calendar adjustments, though each option presents scheduling difficulties. Players have voiced a strong preference to remain at the larger facility if possible. The franchise recently announced a multi-year agreement to play all home games at State Farm Arena starting next season, which will permanently prevent future arena clashes.

sections.heading: Broader implications of the series
paragraphs: The competitive balance of this year's finals highlights the rapid growth and rising standard of professional women's basketball. With packed arenas and intense television audiences following the championship race, every tactical adjustment carries immense weight for the participating franchises. Reaching this deep into October demonstrates the expanding calendar and heightened stakes of the sport.

For cities like Golden State and Atlanta, capturing the championship would mark a milestone achievement for their respective sports communities. The physical intensity displayed throughout the first four games indicates that the remaining fixtures will test the depth and resilience of both squads. Fans across the globe are watching closely to see which roster can secure three more victories.

sections.heading: Upcoming schedule and decisive moments
paragraphs: The immediate focus turns to San Francisco as the Valkyries prepare to host Game 5 on Monday evening. Holding home-court advantage for the next fixture gives the Western Conference contenders an opportunity to pull ahead in the series. Managing player fatigue and defensive intensity will remain critical priorities for both coaching staffs.

If necessary, the series will return to Georgia for the final scheduled dates, depending on how the upcoming encounters unfold. Both organisations understand the narrow margin for error remaining in the campaign. Supporters can expect fiercely contested basketball as the league draws closer to crowning its ultimate winner.
